newsitem.title: USA: USX-Delhi Group names Gradick president.
newsitem.headline: USX-Delhi Group names Gradick president.

text.p: USX Corp said G.G. Gradick was elected president of USX-Delhi Group and president of Delhi Gas Pipeline Corp effective on Tuesday.
Gradick, 52, succeeded David Kihneman, who was leaving Delhi to pursue other interests, the company said. Gradick had beem executive vice president-supply and operations for Delhi.
Gradick joined Delhi Gas in 1978 as chief reservoir engineer and held a variety of positions somce then.

USX-Delhi Group is a Dallas-based unit of USX Corp and includes Delhi Gas Pipeline Corp and certain other subsidiaries of USX. It is involved in purchasing, gathering, processing, treating, transporting and marketing natural gas.
